title: cleistanthus sumatranus
intro: Cleistanthus sumatranus, commonly known as Sumatran cleistanthus, is a plant species native to the island of Sumatra in Indonesia, belonging to the family Phyllanthaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Indonesia, to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Cleistanthus sumatranus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help in managing fever, wounds, and other infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
